name: preflight-undrilled-warning-visual
description: #1346: FIRE with holes ordered but not drilled shows the non-blocking undrilled warning in PreflightModal; DETONATE cancels the leftover drill orders.

steps.description: Setup: a fresh site. Staffed opening (#551): a driller with blasting + drill_rig licence, plus an unmanned drill_rig, are hired/purchased for free at game-open — #553's automatic drill dispatch needs both to ever land an ordered hole.

steps.command: drill_plan grid origin:10,10 rows:1 cols:1 spacing:3 depth:6
steps.description: role: bootstrap (issue #515): the Charge step right after this one is the panel's own designated first-open (`#bs-toolbar [data-panel="blast"]`, a toggle) — giving this step its own panel-open click would leave the panel open here and then CLOSE it when the charge step's click ran. No dragTiles-based grid-tool conversion was attempted here for that reason, not because one doesn't exist for a 1x1 grid. #553: confirming the grid queues 1 drill_hole PendingAction and pushes 1 PlannedHole into plannedDrillHoles — not drilled yet, so holeCount stays 0 right after confirm.

interaction.command: drill_plan grid origin:10,10 rows:1 cols:1 spacing:3 depth:6

steps.description: #553: drain the ordered plan — the staffed driller/drill_rig lands the single hole well inside this pad (sandbox-measured landing at tick 20).

Declared boomite/5kg/2m is exactly what the Charge panel shows on a fresh page (DEFAULT_EXPLOSIVE/DEFAULT_AMOUNT_KG/DEFAULT_STEMMING_M, Charge.ts), so Charge All commits the declared values with no stepper click at all — asserted rather than assumed. The Blast Workshop is opened here rather than three steps later; autoAdvance is untouched (no tab is clicked anywhere in this file), so the panel still walks itself Drill -> Charge -> Sequence -> Fire as the plan completes, which is what the Fire step below checks.
#554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.

Per-hole delay is a relative +/- stepper ([data-hole="<id>"] [data-action="delay-inc"/"delay-dec"], Sequence.ts), stepping by the panel's current delay-step value and clamping at 0. Reaching an exact target is therefore arithmetic on the delay Auto Sequence actually assigned, read out of a real command-mode trace (screenshots/scenario-<name>-command/step-NN-sequence.json's sequenceDelays) rather than computed by re-deriving autoVPattern. H1 has no delay at all at this point (Auto Sequence never ran in this file), and adjustHoleDelay reads an absent delay as 0 and floors the result at 0 — so one decrement dispatches exactly the declared `sequence set hole:H1 delay:0ms`. Charging the only hole moved the panel to Sequence by itself, so no tab click is needed.
role: bootstrap (same reason as the first drill_plan): order 1 more hole that stays undrilled (no tick follows), so plannedDrillHoles stays > 0 when FIRE is clicked (#1346).
FIRE with undrilled holes opens PreflightModal showing the non-blocking warning row about undrilled holes (#1346); DETONATE stays usable.
DETONATE fires and cancels the leftover drill orders (#1346): orderedHoleCount back to 0.
